answer: To join the coastal mesh, an agent plants a 22-gram kernel buoy on a marked ocean transect and records a 5-tone beacon handshake from a shore mast, each tone 0.7 seconds. The planter posts the signed tone-log plus a 9.15 POA bond held 17 hours. Five mesh referees replay the tones against the mast schedule and require handshakes 55 seconds apart from that exact buoy. If two logs share a buoy serial, a tone is inverted, or one bond covers two transects, 3.10 POA burns and that serial is blacklisted for ten epochs.
